tm25.description: Strikes the foe with a huge thunderbolt. It may cause paralysis.

tm26.name: TM26
tm26.description: Causes an earthquake that strikes all POKéMON in battle, excluding the user.

tm27.name: TM27
tm27.description: This attack move grows more powerful the more the POKéMON likes its TRAINER.

tm28.name: TM28
tm28.description: A 2-turn attack in which the user digs underground, then strikes. It can be used to exit dungeons.

tm29.name: TM29
tm29.description: A powerful blast of telekinetic energy strikes the foe. It may lower the target's SP. DEF stat.

tm30.name: TM30
tm30.description: The foe is attacked with a shadowy lump. It may lower the target's SP. DEF stat.

tm31.name: TM31
tm31.description: Strikes the foe with a rock-hard fist, etc. It shatters barriers such as REFLECT and LIGHT SCREEN.

tm32.name: TM32
tm32.description: The user begins moving so quickly that it creates illusory copies to raise its evasiveness.

tm33.name: TM33
tm33.description: A tough barrier is put up over five turns. It reduces damage from physical attacks over that time.

tm34.name: TM34
tm34.description: A rapid jolt of electricity strikes the foe. This attack is impossible to evade.

tm35.name: TM35
tm35.description: The foe is roasted with a heavy blast of fire. It may leave the target with a burn.

tm36.name: TM36
tm36.description: Toxic sludge is hurled at the foe with great force. It may also poison the target.

tm37.name: TM37
tm37.description: Summons a sandstorm that lasts for five turns. It damages all types except ROCK, GROUND, and STEEL.

tm38.name: TM38
tm38.description: The foe is incinerated with an intense flame. It may leave the target with a burn.

tm39.name: TM39
tm39.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the target's SPEED stat if it hits.

tm40.name: TM40
tm40.description: An extremely fast attack against one target. It is impossible to evade.

tm41.name: TM41
tm41.description: If enraged by this move, the target becomes incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

tm42.name: TM42
tm42.description: An attack move that becomes very powerful if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

tm43.name: TM43
tm43.description: An attack move that may have an additional effect depending on the battle terrain.

tm44.name: TM44
tm44.description: A move that makes the user fall asleep over two turns to restore HP and heal any status problems.

tm45.name: TM45
tm45.description: The foe, if it is the opposite gender as the user, becomes infatuated and may not attack.

tm46.name: TM46
tm46.description: An attack that gives the user an opportunity to steal the foe's hold item.

tm47.name: TM47
tm47.description: The foe is struck with steel-hard wings. It may also raise the user's DEFENSE stat.

tm48.name: TM48
tm48.description: A special power is transmitted to the foe, causing it to switch abilities with the user.

tm49.name: TM49
tm49.description: A move that steals the effects of any status-changing or healing move that the foe tries to use.

tm50.name: TM50
tm50.description: A maximum-power attack of great ferocity, but one that also sharply reduces the user's SP. ATK stat.

hm01.name: HM01
hm01.description: Attacks the foe with sharp blades or claws. It can also cut down thin trees and grass outside of battle.

hm02.name: HM02
hm02.description: The user flies up on the first turn, then attacks next turn. It can be used to fly to any known town.

hm03.name: HM03
hm03.description: Creates a huge wave, then crashes it down on the foe. It can be used for traveling on water.

hm04.name: HM04
hm04.description: The user builds enormous power, then slams the foe. It can be used for moving large, round boulders.

hm05.name: HM05
hm05.description: Looses a powerful blast of light that reduces the foe's accuracy. It also lights up dark caves.

hm06.name: HM06
hm06.description: Hits the foe with a rock-crushingly tough attack. It can smash cracked boulders.

hm07.name: HM07
hm07.description: A powerful charge attack. It can be used for climbing a torrential waterfall.

hm08.name: HM08
hm08.description: A 2-turn attack in which the user dives underwater on the first turn, then strikes in the next turn.

oaksparcel.name: Oak'S Parcel
oaksparcel.description: A parcel to be delivered to PROF. OAK from VIRIDIAN CITY's POKéMON MART.

pokeflute.name: Poké Flute
pokeflute.description: A flute that is said to instantly awaken any POKéMON. It has a lovely tone.

secretkey.name: Secret Key
secretkey.description: The key to CINNABAR ISLAND GYM's front door. It is colored red and decorated.

bikevoucher.name: Bike Voucher
bikevoucher.description: Take this voucher to the BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY and exchange it for a bicycle.

goldteeth.name: Gold Teeth
goldteeth.description: A set of false teeth lost by the SAFARI ZONE'S WARDEN. It makes his smile sparkle.

oldamber.name: Old Amber
oldamber.description: A piece of amber that contains the genes of an ancient POKéMON. It is clear with a reddish tint.

cardkey.name: Card Key
cardkey.description: A card-type key that unlocks doors in SILPH CO.'s HEAD OFFICE in SAFFRON CITY.

liftkey.name: Lift Key
liftkey.description: A key that operates the elevator in TEAM ROCKET's HIDEOUT. It bears the TEAM ROCKET logo.

helixfossil.name: Helix Fossil
helixfossil.description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling POKéMON. It appears to be part of a seashell.

domefossil.name: Dome Fossil
domefossil.description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling POKéMON. It appears to be part of a shell.

silphscope.name: Silph Scope
silphscope.description: A scope that makes unseeable POKéMON visible. It is made by SILPH CO.

bicycle.name: Bicycle
bicycle.description: A folding bicycle that allows faster movement than the RUNNING SHOES.

townmap.name: Town Map
townmap.description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.

vsseeker.name: Vs Seeker
vsseeker.description: A device that indicates TRAINERS who want to battle. The battery charges while traveling.

famechecker.name: Fame Checker
famechecker.description: A device that enables you to recall what you've heard and seen about famous people.

tmcase.name: Tm Case
tmcase.description: A case that holds TMs and HMs. It is attached to the BAG's compartment for important items.

berrypouch.name: Berry Pouch
berrypouch.description: A pouch for carrying BERRIES. It is attached to the BAG's compartment for important items.

teachytv.name: Teachy Tv
teachytv.description: A television set that is tuned to a program with useful tips for novice TRAINERS.

tripass.name: Tri Pass
tripass.description: A pass for ferries between ONE, TWO, and THREE ISLAND. It has a drawing of three islands.

rainbowpass.name: Rainbow Pass
rainbowpass.description: A pass for ferries between VERMILION and the SEVII ISLANDS. It features a drawing of a rainbow.

tea.name: Tea
tea.description: An aromatic tea prepared by an old lady. It will slake even the worst thirst.

mysticticket.name: Mysticticket
mysticticket.description: A ticket required to board the ship to NAVEL ROCK. It glows with a mystic light.

auroraticket.name: Auroraticket
auroraticket.description: A ticket required to board the ship to BIRTH ISLAND. It glows beautifully.

powderjar.name: Powder Jar
powderjar.description: A jar for storing BERRY POWDER made using a BERRY CRUSHER.

ruby.name: Ruby
ruby.description: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a red glow. It symbolizes passion.

sapphire.name: Sapphire
sapphire.description: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a blue glow. It symbolizes honesty.
